text:
The corrupted element is most likely **Mq6**. Every other pull-up current source (Mq0–Mq5) is 5.409 µm wide, matching the bias diode Mb2. Mq6 is 0.8113 µm, about 6.7× smaller, so it sources far less current than the bias ratio requires. That weakens the output-stage pull-up and explains the swing shortfall, while the other specs still pass.

This reduces the output-stage pull-up current about 6.7x, causing the output swing shortfall (1.383 V vs 1.61 V)."}
